profile.headline: SENIOR .NET ARCHITECT | SOLUTION ARCHITECT | AZURE | MCP & AI | TRAVEL TECHNOLOGY
profile.summary:
Senior .NET Architect with 17+ years of experience designing, modernizing and delivering enterprise-scale distributed systems
on the Microsoft stack. 9+ years of specialized travel and hospitality technology experience at Reservations.com, leading
architecture for hotel and car-rental booking platforms, travel APIs, payment processing, advertising integrations and
high-volume reservation workflows.
Architect of API-to-MCP server and Web MCP solutions in .NET that make existing enterprise capabilities available to AI
agents through the Model Context Protocol. Combines API-first, cloud-native design on .NET Core and Azure with strong
attention to security, scalability, performance and maintainability, and pairs architectural decision-making with hands-on
delivery, architecture and code reviews, and mentoring.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer and Architect
positions.description:
AI & MCP
• Architect and build API-to-MCP server and Web MCP solutions in .NET that expose enterprise APIs and application
capabilities through the Model Context Protocol, integrated with existing web services.
• Assess service architectures for MCP exposure against security, scalability, maintainability and compatibility with existing systems.
Platform & APIs
• Provide architecture and hands-on technical leadership for hotel and car-rental reservation applications on C#, .NET Core,Azure, SQL Server, Redis and NoSQL.
• Design and maintain RESTful Web APIs that power hotel and car-rental booking.
• Own integrations with Google Ads, Bing Ads, Facebook, Stripe and the TRX Payment Gateway.
• Create reusable NuGet packages and shared .NET libraries to standardize reuse, versioning and deployment.
Performance & Data
• Design caching on Redis and Azure Blob Storage to improve response times and reduce unnecessary database calls.
• Develop SQL Server stored procedures, functions, triggers, optimized queries, SSIS packages and ETL processes.
Operations & Leadership
• Implement monitoring and diagnostics with Azure Portal and Application Insights.
• Automate deployment, administration, data processing and backup/restore with PowerShell and SQL.
• Provide architecture guidance and knowledge sharing to engineering teams through Jira and Confluence.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Knowledge sharing and collaboration with team members using Jira-Confluence for knowledge-sharing with
transparency and efficiency.
Track bugs, future work requests, User Story using Jira Software to manage the entire development process
each stage.
Develop Project Reference DLL and Services Package using NuGet Packages to achieve project requirements
and easy version maintaining with deployment.
Create SSIS (SQL Server Integration Service) Packages and Data Transformations, ETL Query using SQL Server
Data Tool (SSDT) for Origin to Source Data Mapping capabilities.
Develop Web API Application with .Net MVC Technology to integrate Google Ads, Bing, Facebook API for
campaign management with Google Ads, Bing Ads, and Facebook Ads.
Design, implement scalable and reliable web applications and services for Hotel and Car Rental Booking with
Latest .Net Core Technology, Azure Cloud Service, No SQL Database Like Redis and Document DB.
Build, extend relational databases and associated objects (Stored Procedure, SQL function, Trigger) using SQL Server Management Studio and Azure Data Studio to support applications from the backend side.
Design and Develop Caching mechanism with Blob Storage and Redis cache to achieve great performance and avoid an unnecessary trip to database calls.
Payment integration using Stripe and TRX Payment Gateway with .Net Web API, MVC, Postman to Collect,
Refund and Dispute payment Transaction.
Create Windows and Azure PowerShell Script, SQL Scripts using SSMS and Power Shell IDE to automate
administration tasks such as deployment, site health, Internal helping tool, Import/Export Data, redact
sensitive data from vendor server access and backup and restore data and application files on servers.
Develop interactive dashboard and alerting system in Azure portal & application insight to detect and
diagnose exceptions and application performance issues.

Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues and bugs to maintain system stability.

projects.title: IPro Anesthesia
projects.description:
•	Descriptions: IPad/Portal Application to track and estimate the Anesthesia to be given based on patients’ records. 
The IPro Anesthesia system is a platform that manage records for patient, facility and make a collaboration between them. Patient/Medical Operator make online appointment with particular facility and doctor. 
This application manage facility location and Anesthesia doctors. Scheduling appointments, manage patient’s case details along with patient’s full details.
The architecture consists of several layers:
• Web Interface Layer • Presentation Layer • Service Layer • Business Layer
• Data Layer • Common Layer
Create an API Layer using web interface and service layer to provide IPad and Web portal application access to our system to transaction with our service.
•	Technology: ASP.Net (C#.Net), JavaScript and CSS, AJAX, jQuery, Web Services, XML, SQL Server, SSRS, SSIS, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Bootstrap, Angular JS
•	Platform: Microsoft .Net Framework 4.0
